summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is javascript-obfuscator output (hex-named identifiers such as _0x488df8, _0x52943e, string-object dispatch like _0x19328d.YCZJE) that downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at bun-v1.3.13, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js during `npm install`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated string-array cipher) that is opaque and not inspectable as source. The package's advertised purpose is a GraphQL compatibility checker for Node and has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a compiled Bun payload. The composition — obfuscated lifecycle script + alternate-runtime dropper + opaque bundled blob executed on install — is an install-time RCE vector that evades Node-based review and scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
